scope: Read-only source census; no runtime behavior changes and no store writes.

remainingRequiredGates.consumerBehavior: Ascending gate count participates in stable task ordering.

estimatedMinutes.consumerBehavior: Ascending estimate participates in stable task ordering.

lowRankScore.consumerBehavior: Fallback score field is recognized when reading challenger rows.

pythonLowRankChallenger.evidence: The producer documentation says it consumes featureVector.features, excludes placeholder lowRankScore and advisory selection from features, and marks deterministic goalRank leakage. Its feature list includes qualified estimatedMinutes/remainingRequiredGates only through WorkboardFeatureVectorV1 cells.

rankerV2.evidence: Retains defaults for remainingRequiredGates=999, estimatedMinutes=15, and lowRankScore=0.5.

retirementDecision.reason: Defaults still influence deterministic ordering and the tournament parser still accepts lowRankScore. Remove only after consumers migrate to qualified feature cells and replay proves ordering/selection compatibility.
